description: Free (rate-limited per client and per day). Should I pay this x402 URL? Start here before any paid tool. One label (checks_passed / check_first / checks_failed / no_data) plus the allow / warn / block verdict with coded reasons, from Lumi's daily CDP Bazaar index, free 402-quote checks and Lumi's own test-buys (Base USDC for Bazaar listings; XRPL only for a small curated vendor list, counted separately). Pass url, and optionally the payTo and USD amount you were quoted, to catch address or price mismatches. Links the free lookup and, for curated vendors, the paid full report. Observations, not a guarantee. Near the top of the result, paid_option names the paid high-value check (lumi_high_value_check; its price is in its own description), which returns the same verdict and score.
